title: Regular board meeting — November 2026
summary: Elm Ridge coating contract, winter well maintenance, and the first look at the 2027 capital list.
agenda:
Agenda (story)

1. Public comment. 2. Elm Ridge tank coating bids. 3. Well 4 rehabilitation scope. 4. 2027 capital list — first look: Mill Creek main replacement design. 5. Manager's report: Main Street notice after-action.

title: Regular board meeting — October 2026
summary: Q3 quality snapshot accepted; hydrant flushing and tank-cleaning schedule approved; no rate action.
agenda:
Minutes summary (story)

The board accepted the Q3 quality snapshot, approved the fall flushing schedule, and directed staff to publish resolved alerts with a one-paragraph cause — the practice this site demonstrates.

title: Rate hearing and regular meeting — December 2025
summary: The hearing behind the 2026 tiered rates on the Rates page: why tier 3 rose most, and the leak-adjustment policy adopted the same night.
agenda:
Minutes summary (story)

Fourteen residents spoke (story). The board adopted tiers as published, added the once-a-year leak adjustment, and required rates to be published as a web table, not only a PDF — which is why /rates-and-fees looks the way it does.

title: Special meeting: Main Street main replacement design
summary: Design contract for replacing the 1962 cast-iron main under Main Street — the same segment behind this fall's repair and boil notice.
agenda:
Minutes summary (story)

Staff presented break history (story: 6 breaks in 4 years). The board authorized design only, with construction phasing to keep at least one lane and business water service during work.
